title: In Situ Hybridization Protocol
author: Xiong Xinwei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9qhh5t6
materials: Color development: use DAB Chromogenic Substrate Kit (Catalog Number: AR1025) —add one drop(50μL) Reagent A (DAB Chromogen Concentrate), one drop (50μL) Reagent B (H2O2 Concentrate) and one drop(50μL) Reagent C (TBS buffer Concentrate) to 1mL distilled water and mix well. Then add the mixture to the specimen. Control color development under a microscope within 30 minutes. Continue to develop if there is no staining background. Wash the slide well with water.

steps.title: Prepare required buffers and solutions
steps.instruction: Make all buffers listed below before starting the assay.

substeps.instruction: 3% citric acid: dissolve 3 g citric acid in 100 mL distilled water; adjust pH to ~2.0.
2X SSC: dissolve 17.6 g NaCl and 8.8 g Na3C6H5O7·2H2O in 1000 mL distilled water.
0.5X SSC: mix 100 mL 2X SSC with 300 mL distilled water.
0.2X SSC: mix 30 mL 2X SSC with 270 mL distilled water.
20% glycerin: combine 20 mL glycerin with 80 mL distilled water.
0.5M PBS: dissolve 30 g NaCl, 6 g Na2HPO4·12H2O, and 0.4 g NaH2PO4·2H2O in 1000 mL distilled water; adjust pH to 7.2‑7.6.

steps.title: Inactivate endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Treat each slide with a 1:50 mixture of 30% H2O2 and methanol at room temperature for 30 minutes, then rinse with distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Mix 30% H2O2 and CH3OH in a 1:50 ratio.
Apply the mixture to the slide; incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Wash slide with distilled water.

steps.title: Section paraffin‑embedded samples
steps.instruction: Prepare tissue sections by standard paraffin microtomy and mount them on glass slides.

steps.title: Pepsin digestion of tissue sections
steps.instruction: Digest sections with pepsin diluted in 3% citric acid, then wash with 0.5M PBS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare pepsin solution: mix 1 mL 30% citric acid with two drops of concentrated pepsin.
Apply pepsin solution to the section and incubate at 37 °C (or room temperature) for 3–30 minutes, adjusting time for tissue thickness.
Wash slide 3 times with 0.5M PBS, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Prehybridization incubation
steps.instruction: Moisten the hybridization chamber, add pre‑hybridization solution to each slide, and incubate at 37 °C for 3 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 mL 20% glycerin to the bottom of the dry hybridization chamber to keep it moist.
Apply 20 µL pre‑hybridization solution onto each slide.
Incubate slides in a 37 °C incubator for 3 hours.
Absorb excess liquid; do not wash.

steps.title: Hybridize digoxin‑labeled probe
steps.instruction: Apply digoxin‑labeled oligonucleotide probe diluted to 0.5–2 µg/mL (60 ng per slide), cover, and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the digoxin‑labeled probe in hybridization diluent to a final concentration of 0.5–2 µg/mL.
Apply 60 ng of the probe mixture to each slide.
Remove the protective film of the ISH‑specific coverslip and place the coverslip on the slide.
Hybridize overnight in a 37 °C incubator.

steps.title: Post‑hybridization washes
steps.instruction: Perform a series of SSC washes at 37 °C as described, repeating if needed.

substeps.instruction: Remove the coverslip.
Wash twice with 2X SSC at 37 °C for 5 minutes each.
Wash once with 0.5X SSC at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Wash once with 0.2X SSC at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Repeat the wash series as necessary.

steps.title: Remove coverslip and equilibrate slide
steps.instruction: Place the slide in 37 °C 2X SSC, allow the coverslip to fall off naturally; gentle vibration may be used.

substeps.instruction: Stand the slide on 37 °C 2X SSC.
Let the coverslip detach naturally; apply gentle vibration if required.

steps.title: Block nonspecific binding
steps.instruction: Add blocking solution, incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, then discard excess without washing.

substeps.instruction: Apply blocking solution to the slide.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Discard excess solution; do not wash.

steps.title: Incubate with biotinylated anti‑digoxin
steps.instruction: Apply biotinylated mouse anti‑digoxin antibody, incubate, then wash with 0.5M PBS.

substeps.instruction: Add biotinylated mouse anti‑digoxin antibody to the slide.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (or at room temperature for 120 minutes).
Wash 4 times with 0.5M PBS, 5 minutes each; do not use other buffers or distilled water.

steps.title: Incubate with SABC complex
steps.instruction: Add SABC reagent, incubate, then wash with 0.5M PBS.

substeps.instruction: Apply SABC (streptavidin‑biotin complex) to the slide.
Incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes.
Wash 3 times with 0.5M PBS, 5 minutes each; do not use other buffers or distilled water.

steps.title: Incubate with biotinylated peroxidase
steps.instruction: Add biotinylated peroxidase, incubate, then wash with 0.5M PBS.

substeps.instruction: Apply biotinylated peroxidase to the slide.
Incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes.
Wash 4 times with 0.5M PBS, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Mount slides with aqueous medium
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL AR1018 water‑soluble mounting media per slide, replace the ISH coverslip, and seal.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL AR1018 mounting medium to each slide.
Remove the protective film of the ISH‑specific coverslip and place a fresh coverslip on the slide.

steps.title: Visualize under microscope
steps.instruction: Examine the prepared slides using a light microscope.
